name: Mivtach Shamir Holdings Ltd
summary: Mivtach Shamir Holdings Ltd is a venture capital and private equity firm specializing in direct investments and indirect investments. The firm specializes in startups, seed, round A and round B. The firm seeks to invest in venture capital funds. It seeks to make investments in biomed, agrotechnology, information security, technology and communications, energy, financing, real-estate and industrial. It also seeks to invest in Israel, India, Europe and United States. Mivtach Shamir Holdings Ltd was founded in 1958 and is based in Tel Aviv, Israel.
